name: Figured silk weaving
summary: The weaving of patterns into silk cloth on a draw loom, so that flowers and ribbons appear in the weave of the cloth.
how: Set up the loom with a pattern of cords that lift the warp threads in a set order.
Weave the ground in satin or taffeta, and float the coloured or gold weft to make the pattern.
Press the cloth and cut it with the pattern in scale with the gown.

origin.note: The silk trade of Lyon grows from the royal privilege that Francis I gives to the city in 1536.

adoptions.via: Lyon mills weave light flower brocades for the Rococo gowns of the French court.
